theme: 3 terms on the top of a screen: the system strip, the button in the bar, and the big title

terms.definition: The strip at the top of the screen that shows the time, battery and signal.
terms.example: Make the Status Bar light, so it is readable on the dark header.

terms.definition: A button that you place in a navigation bar or toolbar.
terms.example: Add a Bar Button Item for creating a new note.

terms.definition: A big title at the top of a screen that shrinks when the user scrolls.
terms.example: Turn on the Large Title for the main list.

video.title: Status Bar, Bar Button Item & Large Title | Day 130
video.description:
Learn to explain the top bars of an iOS screen: Status Bar, Bar Button Item & Large Title, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Status Bar - The strip at the top of the screen that shows the time, battery and signal.
Bar Button Item - A button that you place in a navigation bar or toolbar.
Large Title - A big title at the top of a screen that shrinks when the user scrolls.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 130 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: iOS Status Bar, Bar Button Item & Large Title | Day 130
landscape.description:
Explain Status Bar, Bar Button Item & Large Title in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
스테이터스 바, 바 버튼 아이템, 라지 타이틀 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Status Bar - The strip at the top of the screen that shows the time, battery and signal.
한국어: 스테이터스 바: 화면 맨 위에서 시간, 배터리, 신호를 보여 주는 띠

Bar Button Item - A button that you place in a navigation bar or toolbar.
한국어: 바 버튼 아이템: 내비게이션 바나 툴바에 놓는 버튼

Large Title - A big title at the top of a screen that shrinks when the user scrolls.
한국어: 라지 타이틀: 스크롤하면 작아지는 화면 맨 위의 큰 제목

In this video, Mina and Jake give the notes screen a large title and an add button, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

dialogue.title: A modern notes screen

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I want the notes screen to feel more modern.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Turn on a Large Title, like in the code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does the Large Title show Notes in big letters?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. And it shrinks when the user scrolls.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nice. I also want an add button on the right.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Create a Bar Button Item with the `.add` system item.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Every Bar Button Item belongs to the navigation item.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The Status Bar text is dark on my dark header.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Change the Status Bar style to light content.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Override `preferredStatusBarStyle` in the view controller, so the Status Bar stays readable.

dialogue.code:
navigationController.navigationBar
    .prefersLargeTitles = true
let add = UIBarButtonItem(systemItem: .add)
navigationItem.rightBarButtonItem = add

lines.text: Make the Status Bar light on a dark header.
